title: Splitting the zero slice of the punctured normalization test
statement: Let S be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, c:C→S a qcqs smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, σ:S→C a section, and G a finite group [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let q:Cη→Spec k(S) and j:Cη→C exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let sη:Spec k(S)→Cη satisfy sη followed by q=id and sη followed by j=aη followed by σ. Let Z→Cη be a finite etale G-torsor with a rational point over sη. Let U be an open of S containing η, jU:Cη→C_U with jU followed by the open inclusion equal to j, PA→C_U a finite etale morphism, and ψ:Z→PA a comparison whose square with jU is cartesian. Let s lie outside U and assume every point outside U specializing to s equals s. Put A=O_{S,s}, a:Spec A→S, L=C×_S Spec A, τ=(a followed by σ,id), and n:N×_C L→L for the relative normalization N of PA→C_U→C [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. For any d≥0 and t:T=Spec A[[X_1,...,X_d]]→L, assume its local-base projection is Spec(C) and its composite with the entire zero section is τ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Set F=pullback n t, r:F→T, E=∐_G T with fold p:E→T, V=(t followed by L→C) inverse image C_U, and z:V_0→V the restricted zero section. There exists an isomorphism e:pullback(p restricted to V,z)≅pullback(r restricted to V,z) satisfying e.hom followed by the second projection equals the second projection of the first pullback. No depth hypothesis, flatness of t, or global finiteness of n is required. The assertion concerns only V_0, not V.

proof.text: Split the section pullback of PA on the original open U using section_finiteEtale_generic_split. This retains the generic rational point and torsor argument and normal generic full faithfulness, but avoids extending the action on PA.

Prove the normalization_open_comparison: PA is the pullback of PA→C_U→C to C_U since the open immersion is mono. This pullback is finite, so its toNormalization is an isomorphism. Compose that isomorphism with normalizationPullback along the open immersion, which is an isomorphism by smooth normalization base change. Its projection equation follows from normalizationPullback_snd and toNormalization_fromNormalization. Paste cartesian squares to base-change this comparison along any section map into C_U.

Construct the restricted section b by the morphismRestrict cartesian square. For the actual zero-slice base B=ζ⁻¹V, let w=z followed by (t followed by the local-total-space projection) restricted to C_U, and wU=w followed by c restricted to U. The entire-section equation gives wU followed by b=w by cancellation of the open immersion. Identify the normalized slice with the base change along wU of the PA section cover using restricted_pullback, composed_pullback and normalization_open_section. Universal finite coproducts give the corresponding constant-cover comparisons. Base-change the section isomorphism using pullback.map, and compose with both comparisons. Rewrite their second-projection equations to prove the final base equation. No punctured-point calculation or formal base-projection equation is needed.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_formal_zero_slice_split {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    ∀ (d : ℕ)
      (t : Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s))) ⟶ pullback c a),
      t ≫ pullback.snd c a =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin d))) →
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d))) ≫ t = τ →
      let T := Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (S.presheaf.stalk s)))
      let F : Scheme.{u} := pullback n t
      let E : Scheme.{u} := ∐ (fun _ : G ↦ T)
      let V := (t ≫ pullback.fst c a) ⁻¹ᵁ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      let r : F ⟶ T := pullback.snd n t
      let p : E ⟶ T := Sigma.desc (fun _ : G ↦ 𝟙 T)
      let z := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) ∣_ V
      ∃ e : pullback (p ∣_ V) z ≅ pullback (r ∣_ V) z,
        e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (r ∣_ V) z = pullback.snd (p ∣_ V) z
